lastCompletedStory.title: Flip the implementer spawn through the container (fail-closed) + ADR

nextStoryContext: US-004 (B-2 CAM-152) is complete. loop.ts now: (1) reads opts.workerIsolation ('host'|'container'); (2) wraps shellCmd via dockerExecWrap() before respawn-pane when container mode; (3) is fail-closed: if preflightContainerFn returns ready:false in container mode, calls escalateFn and returns { status: 'blocked', detail: 'container-not-ready: ...' } without ever dispatching a worker; (4) routes pane-died in container mode to 'container-exec-failure' reason. host.ts wires workerIsolation via readWorkerIsolation(). ADR 0003 updated to document the flip. Tests added: 7 new tests in 'US-004 / B-2: container mode dispatch' describe block. The docker exec string format is 'docker exec -it cam-worker env -u CLAUDECODE ... claude ... --session-id <lowercase-uuid> ...'. All quality gates pass. Next story may be the final US-005 or operator-required stories.

officialDocsValidated.summary: docker exec -it passes the command via shell tokenization when invoked through a tmux pane shell. The -i flag keeps STDIN open, -t allocates a pseudo-TTY. The dockerExecWrap implementation (prefix + inner shellCmd string) is correct for the tmux respawn-pane invocation path where the pane shell tokenizes the combined string.
